title: The intake pilot
brief: Create exactly 6 slides for collaborators deciding whether to extend the intake pilot. Explain the time result, what was not measured, and why a decision needs that limitation.

sources.title: Intake pilot timing log
sources.text: In this synthetic intake pilot, median review time was 40 hours before the pilot and 16 hours during the pilot. The observation covered two teams over eight weeks. These are training data, not actual organizational results.

sources.title: Intake pilot scope note
sources.text: The two-team intake pilot did not measure review quality or error rates. A faster review cannot establish a quality improvement. The sample does not establish an effect in other teams.

sources.title: Intake pilot decision note

title: 社区阅读讨论
brief: 为学生制作恰好6页阅读型讲义。先说明为什么会有分歧，再区分两种主张的证据与局限。不要编造统计数据。

## 两种阅读安排尚未形成统一决定 [1][2]

- **自主选书**：照顾不同兴趣。 [1]
- **证据范围**：讨论意见没有测量学习效果。 [1][2]

title: An uneven series

title: Checking an application
brief: Create exactly 6 slides teaching the documented conditional review process. Explain the condition before using the branch. Do not show both possible outcomes as consecutive steps.

sources.title: Application handling procedure
sources.text: First collect the application, then check whether required information is complete. If it is complete, begin analysis. If it is incomplete, request missing information. These are conditional alternatives, not consecutive outcomes.

sources.title: Procedure boundaries
sources.text: The procedure does not specify completion times, acceptance rates, or who is responsible. Requesting missing information does not itself mean the application is rejected.

slides.body:
## Collection precedes the completeness check [1]

1. **Collect**: retain the application. [1]
2. **Check**: determine whether required information is complete. [1]

The check leads to alternative actions; both outcomes are not consecutive steps. [1]

title: Results that disagree
brief: Create exactly 6 slides for researchers comparing two records. Preserve their different scopes and the disagreement. Do not select a winner or make a pooled estimate.

sources.title: Training study A
sources.text: In synthetic study A, the reported change was 12% in a supervised laboratory setting. It did not evaluate field use.

sources.title: Training study B
sources.text: In synthetic study B, the reported change was 3% during field use. It did not use the laboratory supervision from study A.

sources.title: Comparison constraints
sources.text: The two studies used different settings. Their records do not isolate the reason for the difference. They do not support a pooled estimate or a declaration that one method is better.

slides.body:
## The reported changes come from different settings [1][2]

| Record | Setting | Reported change |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Study A | Supervised laboratory [1] | 12% [1] |
| Study B | Field use [2] | 3% [2] |

The records do not isolate the difference or support a pooled estimate. [3]
